purpose: Qualify endpoint-safe within-species spatial detectability on the exact fresh Phase-2 survivor geometry before empirical nucleotide identity is opened, so a later cross-species negative can be distinguished from failure to detect within-species spatial structure.

geometry.evaluated_species: the exact inherited Phase-2 evaluation species

inference.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean of finite held-out species self-field Spearman scores
inference.p_value: upper Monte Carlo p = (1 + number of independent reference statistics >= observed statistic) / (1000 + 1)

qualification.overall_pass: both Type-I and private-A2 power gates pass
qualification.failure_interpretation: SELF_DETECTABILITY_NOT_QUALIFIED; a later empirical cross-species negative cannot be interpreted as lineage-conditioned

execution.sharding_semantics: absolute replicate index only; execution partition cannot change world identity

interpretation_contract.if_pass_and_empirical_cross_species_nega: eligible for lineage-conditioned interpretation, subject to the empirical test itself being valid
interpretation_contract.empirical_cross_species_positive: does not require self-detectability PASS for the transferable-place interpretation

forbidden_after_freeze: changing self-field bandwidth or endpoint exclusion
changing reference/evaluation world counts or seed tags
dropping difficult evaluation species based on self scores
opening empirical nucleotide identity before this qualification completes
